drawings.title: Location plan
drawings.detail: A plan that identifies the land. Guidance: typically at 1:1250 or 1:2500 on A4 or A3, the site edged in red, other land the applicant owns nearby edged in blue, enough roads or buildings to make the location clear. Drawn to an identified scale and showing north.

drawings.title: Other plans and drawings needed to describe the development
drawings.detail: Any other plans, drawings and information necessary to describe the development, each drawn to an identified scale; plans show the direction of north.

documents.title: Application form
documents.detail: Made in writing on the form published by the Secretary of State, with the particulars the form asks for.

documents.title: Ownership certificate and agricultural land declaration
documents.detail: The relevant certificate (A, B, C or D) completed; the application is not valid without it.

documents.title: The correct fee
documents.detail: A valid application needs the correct fee.

documents.title: Design and access statement
documents.detail: For some applications, among them major development, and in a conservation area or World Heritage Site one or more dwellings or a building of 100 square metres or more.

documents.title: Fire statement
documents.detail: For some applications made on or after 1 August 2021.

documents.title: Biodiversity gain information
documents.detail: Whether the biodiversity gain condition would apply and, if it would, the metric calculation and the habitat information the article lists.

documents.title: Local information requirements
documents.detail: Whatever the local planning authority's published local list asks for.
